standard: A custody engine is accepted only when it preserves result custody across provider/runtime failure and coordinator restart without false completion, lost committed results, stale-owner commits, duplicate external effects, or unverifiable artifacts.

criteria.requirement: Provider completion without a durable result commit is represented as PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED and cannot become COMPLETED.
Only the coordinator may set COMPLETED, and completion requires parent ingestion after result commit.
A committed result has complete artifact and manifest metadata, exact byte/count accounting, hashes, and independent immutable read-back evidence.
Recovery resumes or reruns from immutable input after lost callbacks, process/runtime loss, partial writes, and parent restart; committed results are recovered 100 percent of the time.
Leases and fencing prevent an expired or stale worker from committing after ownership transfer; duplicate callbacks and retries are idempotent.
External effects are deduplicated across replay and retry, and no producer can bypass coordinator ingestion to reach completion.

decision_rule: REJECT if any mandatory criterion has an executable counterexample or if the claimed evidence cannot be independently reproduced from immutable committed artifacts; ACCEPT only when every exercised criterion passes and unexercised boundaries are explicitly NOT_YET.
